$comment: A census, not a decision. Every row proposes an operating character (ADR-114) from geospatial and inventory evidence and carries needs_review: true. Nothing here is applied to a roster or a payload; a reviewer approves or refuses each row.
The observed series is recorded beside each proposal as agreement or disagreement, and no rule reads it (ADR-114).

rules.restricted: the dated dam-safety orders established in docs/OPERATING-RESTRICTION-REVIEW.md, plus one operator-published restriction with no state date
rules.run_of_river: inventory purposes include navigation or hydroelectric AND the mainstem at the point drains at least 1,000 sq km AND the residence-time proxy is at most 30 days (high confidence below 10 days with a lock or a navigation purpose)
rules.flood_space: the inventory's primary purpose is flood risk reduction AND it publishes no conservation pool, or flood control as its only purpose, or a conservation pool at most 50% of the maximum pool, or the Corps of Engineers operates it. Confidence rises to high where NHD maps the water at no more than 25% of the inventory's pool surface
rules.none: no rule fired; ordinary target-filled storage is unlabelled
rules.natural_lake_flag: NHD FType LakePond AND no inventory record on the roster AND no dam within 2 km AND a GNIS name that is a lake's. FType alone is refused (ADR-078)
rules.residence_time_proxy: proxy: capacity_af / (mean annual flow in cfs x 1.9835 acre-feet per cfs-day), in days. Not a measurement of how the water is operated.
rules.mapped_pool_share: NHDPlus HR mapped water area divided by the inventory's pool surface area. Evidence about how full a pool normally is, not a storage figure.
